items.title: Niche, Vertical, Industry-specific AI models are coming.
items.summary:
Shopify beat GPT-5.6 with a model it trained in a week.
It had one job... build a profile of what each shopper wants.
Shopify's 0.8B model scored 84.6 on those notes, GPT-5.6 scored 83.0. Source:
Tobi Lutke on X
.
Surprise surprise, Shopify's model went from building 2 million profiles to 72 million A DAY.
Pipecat
ran their own model for support calls. Same quality as GPT, but 1/18th of the cost.
Pipecat's small model scored against the big ones on support calls. Source:
Pipecat's post on X
.
Why do you need the entire history of the world in one model??
It's too heavy.
Trend incoming.. I'm calling it... Niche Language Models...
